propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes only emits when local_state carries a jira_key field, but run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot whose entries never carry jira_key.

A hard-deleted Jira issue whose local ticket still exists currently resurrects after 3 passes of confirmed-404 note_absent calls retire the binding, making the local ticket unbound, after which outbound_differ emits an outbound CREATE.

The operator ruling forbids resurrection of deliberately-deleted Jira issues, requiring a tombstone guard to prevent outbound creates for retired pairings while allowing never-bound local tickets to create normally.

The absence-probe path's intended discrimination between deletion and aged-out-of-fetch-window is already implemented live twice: outbound_differ._safe_get_issue and binding_walk.py bounded GETs, both verified on real DC.

The plan removes the dead legacy chain (producer, dispatch arm, router, fixture-only test) and the resurrection implementation, adds BindingStore.is_retired_local/unretire with observable suppression, and corrects ADR 0028 para 2 from c244 resurrection promise to actual tombstone semantics.
